headline: Pedro Out, test211 Short Up Front
deck: João Pedro, owned by test211, ruled out through injury with no return date given
body:
João Pedro is out injured, and test211 lose the forward without a line on how long. The wire has Chelsea unable to score without him, which is the part that matters here: a striker on the treatment table is a striker returning nothing until he is fit.

No timeframe has been given, so none is offered. test211's defenders have already been doing the heavy lifting week to week, and now they do it a man light at the sharp end.
